text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: automated pager fired — service="inference-api" metric=p99_latency region=us-west threshold=1200ms current=1845ms
pagerduty: triggered incident INC-8543 (priority: P1) — paging rotation started
elaine (oncall): acked. looking at traces + p99 shards now. any customer-facing alerts?
sam (sre): seeing a fanout on hot-path model-quant, KV cache miss rate spiked to 78%. requests backed up on sidecar queues.
jeremy (eng): reassigning to model-team for quick fallback. suggest switching traffic to model v2-small for tail mitigation. low perf hit but reduces latency.
elaine (oncall): rolling a targeted route change to v2-small for inference-hotpath in us-west. command: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/routing/swap -d '{"service":"inference-api","from":"model-quant","to":"model-v2-small","region":"us-west","weight":0.3}'`
sam (sre): prewarming KV cache entries for top 50 prefixes. running: `for key in $(cat top50.txt); do curl -s "https://internal-cache/prime?key=$key" & done`
incident-bot: note — autoscaler attempted scale-up but hit quota on g4dn in us-west. policy fell back to dedicated-burst (soft)
elaine (oncall): ok, manual scale: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime -n prod --replicas=12 --context=us-west` — giving 3–5m to stabilize
jeremy (eng): rolling faster fallback: enabling local batching backoff (config `batcher.max_delay_ms=10` -> 5). Pushing change now.
sam (sre): tail latency dropping from 1845ms -> 950ms after partial swap + prewarm. still some p99 spikes ~1.1s. ongoing.
elaine (oncall): tagging incident with customer-impact = "partial degradation: slow responses for large contextual requests". alerting support to prepare status page blurb. @maria (oncall-next) please take handoff at 21:30UTC if this persists.
maria (oncall-next): noted, will be ready to pick up. how long until autoscaler quota cleared?
sam (sre): quota request is pending with cloud team — ETA ~15-30m. meanwhile we can keep fallback routing at 50% to protect SLOs.
elaine (oncall): agreed. moving to 50% traffic on v2-small. leaving canary throttle rules in place. I'll update PD with current mitigation and planned timeline.
pagerduty: INC-8543 update: mitigations in progress, status=investigating -> partial-mitigation. escalation to SRE lead if >30m unresolved.
jeremy (eng): opened a postmortem draft and added checklist items: 1) autoscaler quota review, 2) prewarm automation for top prefixes, 3) model-variant playbook for rapid swap.
elaine (oncall): final note before handoff: p99 baseline now ~820ms, p95 ~220ms. keeping watch for 10m. handoff to @maria at 21:30UTC unless further regression.
maria (oncall-next): ack, taking over at 21:30UTC. I'll monitor dashboards and keep PD updated. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: thread closed to updates from alert pipeline (autosilenced) — manual closure required once normal.
